title: Advance Booking and the Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Deductible
content:
Booking Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment well ahead of pickup lowers the damage deductible.

Booking ahead lowers the deductible: a reservation made at least 7 calendar days before the scheduled pickup date has the deductible multiplied by 0.95; one made 3 to 6 calendar days before, by 0.975; one made fewer than 3 calendar days before keeps it unchanged.

The lead is the calendar days from the reservation date on the agreement to the date part of the booked pickup time.

The multiplier acts on the damage deductible before the deductible is held to the repair cost assessed at the return inspection, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

| Lead, calendar days | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 7 or more | 0.95 |
| 3 to 6 | 0.975 |
| 0 to 2 | 1 (unchanged) |

## Hypothetical figures (deductible of 400.00 before the multiplier, pickup booked for 15 June)

| Reservation date | Lead | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| 8 June | 7 | 380.00 |
| 12 June | 3 | 390.00 |
| 13 June | 2 | 400.00 |
